notes.title: Still the best stealth mechanics around!
notes.content:
So it seems Basingstoke has still got the most innovative stealth mechanics around in an action game! A game where just acting sneaky has the desired effect.

By way of an explanation, some people may not have realised how easy it is to be stealthy in Basingstoke and consequently not enjoyed themselves quite so much as they would have done if they'd known. So here's how it works:


 You don't need to ever use the Sneak key.
 You can run for a couple of seconds before you start to make any noise at all.
 The noise you are making can be seen by a little seismic pulse that emanates from your character. The bigger it goes, the wider the noise radius
 The longer you run, the bigger the noise you make.
 You can see whether you're visible by holding the cursor over your character.
 The radius at which you are visible is from the top to the bottom of the screen.
 If you can't see it, it can't see you!


Hope that helps in your adventures!

Discord
Also, ICYMI, we have a Discord now, which is here.

Battledroid
And we're making a new game, the successor to Revenge of the Titans (which is on sale in the Summer Sale!), and it's called Battledroid, but we need your help!

notes.title: First Free Content Update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31851932/1446ce045f27744574578cd9b2093749e330df24.jpg

Announcing our first big update, which we could call ... the Vicars Update! It coincides with the Steam Summer Sale where for but a fleeting moment you may purchase Basingstoke with a 34% discount!

New Environments

Find refuge in the Church, discover the secrets of the Catacombs, and escape from the Cemetery.

New Player Class and Special Items

Reach the Church and unlock the new Vicar class, and get access to unique items and crafting recipes such as The Holy Waterpistol and the The Holy Hand Grenade.

New 'Horde' Game Mode

Horde Mode is a completely separate new game mode with local and online global leaderboards.

Pick a character with a specific loadout, choose a map, and see how long you can survive against ever-hungrier incursions of Basingtoke's finest citizens. Ammo respawns.


We're continually updating Basingstoke with bug fixes, tweaks, and new content. We've got more environments, character unlocks, items, recipes, monsters, and game modes planned, all for free! We build a new update every night in the "alpha" channel, and promote that to "beta" every two weeks. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Basingstoke Release
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31851932/02ecf06c1d9b7bfca2aad0cd942d0e2e751c7769.png

Basingstoke Is Nearly Here

Minions! Let is be known that our vicious roguelike survival horror game BASINGSTOKE is due for release on the SLIGHTLY ADJUSTED DATE of April 27th, 2018 @ 11:00am PST. Go forth and wishlist it so you'll get a reminder when it finally appears (with a wee discount).

Eh? What's Basingstoke?

We've spent the last four years making a game about escaping a mediocre small town in southern England. Set in the near future, Basingstoke has been invaded by the evil Titans, and nearly everyone has been killed by a neutron bomb. Nearly everyone...

You've got to escape alive through Basingstoke's randomly generated suburban sprawl, looting bodies as you go, crafting new things to help you evade detection, distract your enemies, or just plain old kill them as a last resort. Everything you encounter will kill you instantly, so stealth and planning are the keys to survival. And running away a lot while throwing sausage rolls over your shoulder.

A few more details can be found here on our site.
